summary: Verified the follow-up reminder / status feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_status_and_reminders.py (auth on PATCH status + reminders, valid new/contacted/booked transitions for quotes, application status limited to new/contacted, 400 on invalid status, 404 on missing id, marking contacted stamps reminded_at, reminders endpoint is idempotent, SMTP log contains 'Support notification sent' / 'Client confirmation sent'). Frontend Playwright on /admin (brightadmin): logged in successfully, both seeded REMTEST leads (Sarah Mitchell, James Ortiz) render with status badge 'NEW', overdue-flag testid and amber ring; clicking mark-contacted flips badge to CONTACTED, removes the overdue flag and decrements the 'Awaiting reply' stat from 5 -> 4 with success toast; mark-booked -> booked; back-to-new -> new; status persists after full page reload; Applications tab shows status badge, mark-contacted works, and mark-booked button is NOT rendered. Delete flow was already covered in iteration_1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_quote/delete_application still return 200 even when nothing matched (already flagged iter1, low priority).
server.py: Admin.jsx stores JWT in localStorage — acceptable for scope but note XSS exposure.

server.py run_reminders() uses (_hours_since or 0) >= REMINDER_AFTER_HOURS. If created_at is malformed, _hours_since returns None -> treated as 0 -> the lead never reminds. Fine as a fail-safe; worth a debug log if this ever happens.
Admin.jsx setStatus optimistic update rolls back to item.status || 'new' on failure — correct. Toast on success is generic ('Marked contacted') which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created and cleaned up a handful of TEST_* quotes/applications. Seeded REMTEST-* overdue leads (Sarah Mitchell, James Ortiz) were left in place per instruction; one (Sarah/REMTEST-dc5f7dd0) was flipped through contacted/booked/new during UI test and returned to 'new' at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now exist: backend_test.py (baseline CRUD/auth/forwarding) and test_status_and_reminders.py (Option A status/reminders). Both fully pass against the preview URL. Admin UI /admin login works with playwright by filling input[placeholder='Username'|'Password'] and clicking button[type='submit']; all card actions expose data-testid: status-badge-{id}, mark-contacted-{id}, mark-booked-{id}, mark-new-{id}, overdue-flag-{id}, delete-submission-{id}, submission-card-{id}. Reminder endpoint /api/admin/reminders/run is idempotent — after main agent cleans REMTEST leads, subsequent runs should return 0 unless new >24h 'new' quotes appear.
